detailed_description: The Stacked Area Chart Generator enables developers and data analysts to visualize multi-series temporal data through layered area representations. This tool employs a stacking algorithm to display cumulative contributions of categorical variables along a Y-axis against a time-based X-axis, with each data series rendered as a filled region. Users can choose between absolute value stacking or normalized percentage-based visualization to highlight proportionality. Built with D3.js and SVG rendering, it supports dynamic axis scaling, custom color palettes, and interactive tooltips displaying precise data points. The generator's unique capability lies in its ability to handle irregular time intervals and missing data points through cubic interpolation, making it ideal for financial forecasting, resource allocation analysis, and trend comparison scenarios where data continuity matters. Technical features include support for JSON/CSV data imports, axis label customization, and export options in both vector and raster formats.
usage_steps: 1. Import structured data via CSV/JSON file or manual entry in the grid editor
3. Select stacking mode using the toggle switch between 'Absolute' and 'Percentage' views
4. Configure color encoding through the integrated CIELAB color picker for accessibility compliance
5. Adjust axis ranges manually or enable auto-scaling for dynamic datasets
6. Export the chart as SVG for infinite resolution or PNG with customizable DPI settings
usage_examples: A financial analyst comparing quarterly revenue contributions from different product lines across five years
A mobile app developer visualizing daily active user distribution across Android, iOS, and Web platforms
An energy researcher analyzing hourly electricity generation mix from solar, wind, and fossil sources
A retail manager tracking inventory levels of various clothing categories across multiple store locations
